Pointers on pickup lanes at the skyport
The desk wrote this for busy families
Pickup lanes at the skyport

The Companion Animal Travel Desk helps travelers move pets through the pickup area with less stress and fewer delays. Keep documents ready before you reach the curb, and follow the lane markings and staff directions as soon as you enter the zone.

If you are collecting a pet after a flight on Aurelia Skyways, stay with your party and keep the carrier closed until the desk or ground staff asks you to open it. Calm handling matters. Pets often settle better when people speak softly, move at an even pace, and avoid sudden gestures.

Use the lane only for active loading or unloading. Do not leave the vehicle unattended in the pickup area, and do not block access for other travelers or service carts. If your pet needs extra room, ask the desk team where to wait before you arrive at the curb.

Travelers should also check for any special notes attached to the reservation. A companion animal may need a quick handoff, a health document review, or an escort to the right exit. The desk coordinates these steps so the pickup stays organized and the pet moves through safely.

If you are meeting another traveler, agree on who will carry the carrier, who will manage luggage, and who will guide the pet. Clear roles keep the lane moving and reduce confusion at the curb.

For more help with companion animal pickup arrangements, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
